subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when native open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The current branch changes message admission behavior, but the proposed union_id source is disputed and the wrong identity contract can either keep suppressing addressed messages or admit messages to the wrong bot.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rebuild the fix on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and carrying it through all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context while a broader Feishu multi-bot identity PR becomes the canonical landing path.

options.title: Close This Branch, Keep The Issue
options.body: If union_id remains unavailable for bots, close this stale branch and keep the linked issue open for a different identity strategy.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rebuild the fix on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and carrying it through all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already requested changes on the exact Feishu identity decision surface.
